en: Points of Controversy The Great Fifty-Section The Eighth Chapter
Discussion on the Form Element:
Are material phenomena the form element? Yes.

Is form (rūpa) existence (bhava), a destination (gati), an abode of beings (sattāvāsa), saṃsāra, a womb (yoni), a station of consciousness (viññāṇaṭṭhiti), and the acquisition of a personal identity (attabhāvapaṭilābha)?
One should not say so... [and so on] ...
Is there karma that leads to form? Yes.
It should not be said thus … [as before] … Is it the case that there are beings who have reached the realm of form?
It should not be said thus … [as before] …
Are beings born, grow old, die, pass away, and reappear in form?
One should not say so …pe… Is there in form feeling, perception, volitional formations, and consciousness?
It should not be said thus … [as before] … Is form the five-aggregate existence?
It should not be said thus … [as before] …
Is the existence in the realm of form (rūpadhātu-bhava) a destiny (gati) …pe… a acquisition of an individuality (attabhāvapaṭilābha)? Yes.
Is form existence, a destination, ... [and so on] ...
the acquisition of a personal identity?
One should not say so, ... [and so on] ...
Is there karma that leads to the form realm?
Yes. Is there karma that leads to form? Yes.
It should not be said thus … [as before] … Is it the case that there are beings who have gone to the form realm? Yes.
Is it the case that there are beings who have reached the realm of form?
One should not say so… [as before] … Do beings in the realm of form (rūpadhātu) take birth, age, die, pass away, and reappear?
“Yes. [If you say this,] must you not also admit: “In form, beings are born, age, die, pass away, and reappear”?
You should not speak thus …pe…
Is there in the form element (rūpadhātu) form, feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness?
Yes. Is there in form (rūpa) form, feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness?
It should not be said thus … [as before] … Is the form-element (rūpadhātu) fivefold existence (pañcavokārabhava)? Yes.
Is form the five-aggregate existence?
One should not say so… [as before] … Are material phenomena the form-element? Is there form in the sense-sphere element (kāmadhātu)?
“Yes,” [you say].
“Is that which is the sense-sphere (kāmadhātu) also the form-sphere (rūpadhātu)?
You should not say so …pe…
Is that which is the sense-sphere realm (kāmadhātu) also the fine-material-sphere realm (rūpadhātu)? Yes.
A person endowed with the existence of the sense-sphere (kāmabhava) is endowed with two existences (bhava).
And [is it] by way of sensual existence and by way of fine-material existence?
One should not say so.
The Discussion of the Fine-Material Realm is finished.
